name: Amazon Selling Partner
one_liner: REST-based API for sellers and vendors to access their Amazon business data including orders, shipments, payments, and inventory
needs_human_reasons: pass2 failed; relying on pass1 + registries

evidence.quote: Unauthenticated probe -> HTTP 403; WWW-Authenticate: None; body: {   "errors": [     {       "code": "Unauthorized",       "message": "Access to requested resource is denied.",       "details": "Access token is missing in the request header."     }   ] }

notes: Sellers using the API for their own business operations have free access. Third-party public developers must pass app review and architecture review with SP-API Solutions Architecture team. Private developers can use self-authorization. API breadth unknown from search results.
